cd /tmp/ws && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

# Test \S+ approach
tests = [
    # (pattern, string, description)
    (r'(\S+?) *\s*world', 'hello       world', 'non-greedy \\S'),
    (r'(\S+) *\s*world', 'hello       world', 'greedy \\S'),
    (r'\s*(\S+)\s*', ' hello ', 'center \\S'),
    (r'\s*(\S*)\s*', '   ', 'center empty'),
    (r'\s*(\S+)\s*', '   hello   ', 'center multiple words'),
    (r'(\S+)', 'hello   world', 'standalone \\S'),
]

for p, s, desc in tests:
    m = re.search(p, s)
    if m:
        print(f"{desc}: Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: matched {m.group(1)!r}")
    else:
        print(f"{desc}: Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: no match")
PYEOF
